_doc: Grip and rolling-resistance multipliers per surface, relative to dry race tarmac. Game-calibrated values (no single published source); documented in DECISIONS.md.

kerb.source: painted kerbs offer less grip than asphalt; bump for rumble

grass.source: dry grass roughly half of tarmac grip

gravel.source: gravel traps are designed to decelerate cars: high rolling drag plus speed-proportional drag (N per m/s per wheel-load-kN)

wet._doc: Wetness w in [0,1] (0 dry, 0.3 damp, 0.6 wet, 1 standing water). Grip multiplier per compound family at w = 0, 0.3, 0.6, 1.0.
wet.source: game calibration reflecting the usual crossover order: slicks fastest dry, intermediates in damp/wet, full wets in standing water
